codexRequestExtensions.description: Allow plugin-generated Codex wire identity, metadata, Lite and native compaction. False preserves Standard tools and Pi authentication; Lite requests and opaque checkpoint mode changes are blocked.

endpoint_config.description: Capability allowlists matched by exact provider and Pi-resolved baseUrl (ignoring trailing slashes). Omitted lists inherit the model profile; an empty list disables that capability. Lists never select a different implementation.

$schema.description: JSON Schema URL used by editors for validation and completion.

enabled.description: Enable this package's tools, provider shim, compaction hooks, and commands.

glyphStyle.description: Glyph style used by the extension UI.

autoEnable.description: Automatically activate enabled package tools on supported models.

webSocketEnabled.description: Global Responses WebSocket master switch. false forces SSE and disables WebSocket prewarm for every model profile.

fastMode.description: Fast mode default for new sessions. /fast changes only the current session; subagents follow the main agent. Only profiles declaring a Fast service tier are affected.

imageGeneration.description: Global image-generation master switch. false disables image tools, commands, presentation and standalone endpoints without changing other model-profile behavior.

imageOutputDir.description: Directory for generated images. Relative paths resolve against the workspace root.

imageModel.description: Image model used by standalone generation and edits.

viewImageWorkspaceOnly.description: Reject view_image paths outside the active workspace.

deferApplyPatchRendering.description: Use Pi's fallback tool renderer instead of the built-in streaming filesystem preview.
